summary: This Best Current Practice sets a policy for moderating disruptive participation across the IETF's public mailing lists and other discussion channels. It sets guardrails for moderation and creates a moderator team that will develop procedures and apply them consistently alongside chairs and administrators. It obsoletes RFC 3683 and RFC 3934 and updates RFC 2418 and RFC 9245.

eli5.summary: When kids in a club keep shouting and ruining it for others, the club picks a few helpers with clear rules to calmly stop it.

questions: how does the ietf moderate disruptive participants
